cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Say You Missed Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You're selling the sofa but keeping my chair? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody offered anything for it. Have you brought its cushion back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. If someone offered twenty pounds, would you still keep it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I like pretending you're about to sit down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll admit I sleep with the cushion. Could you take the price sticker off before I sit?

mechanism: A directs furniture sorting while yielding practical work to B, using a chair decision to obtain an admission of attachment before revealing A own cushion attachment.
confusable: Unlike merely disputing ownership, A tests whether B keeps the chair for personal longing; borrowed authority manages the sort while needing B answer.
comparison: Furniture and a hypothetical sale differ from an explicit reunion question with reciprocal terms.
seedUse: Use D88-b chair/sofa/cushion/twenty pounds/sticker and S02-b cooperative adjustments to keep a test going.
